topic: Track your spending for 30 days: the first step to knowing where your money goes.

episode.title: Where Did Your Money Go? Track It for 30 Days

shots.scene: Bright modern flat, small table, vertical 9:16 3D animated frame, no text.
shots.action: Kash tips an empty purse over the table.
shots.mood: Wide curious eyes, raised eyebrows, warm daylight.

shots.narration: Coin suggests tracking spending for 30 days.
shots.scene: Modern flat table with an open blank notebook, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Coin points toward Kash’s open notebook.
shots.mood: Cheerful gold glow, attentive expression, bright friendly colours.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Start with an everyday example: Kash buys a coffee.
shots.scene: Clean modern cafe counter with a plain takeaway cup and payment tray, vertical 9:16, no text or branding.
shots.action: Kash places plain gold coins into the payment tray.
shots.mood: Relaxed smile, soft cafe lighting, inviting pastel colours.

shots.narration: She records that spending in her notebook.
shots.scene: Cafe table with a plain coffee cup and open notebook, vertical 9:16, no letters or numbers.
shots.action: Kash draws a coffee-cup pictogram beside small coin-shaped circles.
shots.mood: Focused eyes, gentle smile, clear uncluttered tabletop.

shots.scene: Modern flat table with a plain grocery bag and pictogram-only notebook, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Kash adds an apple pictogram beside another group of coin-shaped circles.
shots.mood: Calm concentration, bright green apple, warm mustard accents.

shots.scene: Modern flat wall with a wordless grid of exactly thirty circles, twenty-nine already filled, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Coin fills the final circle with a bright gold dot.
shots.mood: Celebratory smile, sparkling gold highlights, clean cheerful colours.

shots.narration: Now Kash has a record of where her money went.
shots.scene: Bright flat table with a closed notebook, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Kash opens the notebook to pages of purchase pictograms and coin-shaped circles.
shots.mood: Delighted recognition, proud little Coin, sunny lighting.

shots.narration: No more guessing about those recorded purchases.
shots.scene: Modern flat table with the open pictogram-only spending notebook, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Coin points to the coffee-cup entry.
shots.mood: Clear visual focus, Kash’s relieved smile, friendly gold glow.

shots.narration: [excited] Record today’s spending; next, we’ll explore Kash’s spending picture.
shots.scene: Bright flat table with an open pictogram-only notebook facing the viewer, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Kash offers a pencil toward the viewer.
shots.mood: Welcoming smiles, inviting open composition, warm hopeful colours.

episode.endHook: Next episode: what does Kash’s spending picture look like?
episode.description: Kash wonders where her money went, and Coin introduces a simple first step: tracking spending for 30 days. Follow their everyday example, then start your own spending record today. General money education only.
